content: Official libsodium documentation recommends XChaCha20-Poly1305 when interoperability is not required because its 192-bit nonce permits random nonces, exposes Argon2id through crypto_pwhash for password-derived keys, provides domain-separated KDF, Ed25519 detached signatures, and X25519-based authenticated crypto_box. The official libsodium.js wrapper requires awaiting sodium.ready; pwhash is in the sumo build.
